mapper.insert: INSERT INTO event_message (id, topic, event_key, payload, status, retry_count, create_time) VALUES (#{id}, #{topic}, #{eventKey}, #{payload}, #{status}, #{retryCount}, #{createTime})
mapper.select: SELECT id, topic, event_key, payload, status, retry_count, create_time FROM event_message WHERE status = 0 ORDER BY create_time ASC LIMIT #{limit}
